title: Do Nothing- a message of motivation from Self-help Singh- (un) motivational speaker and life coach
summary: A short satirical 'motivational' talk by the character Self-help Singh, a sham life coach who urges viewers to do nothing. It parodies self-help gurus and hustle culture.
why: HN commenters recommend it as funny anti-motivational comedy that also touches on real truths about productivity and the rat race.

quote.text: While it's meant to be funny, it actually touches some deeper philosophical truths.
